answer: Per-task collateral forfeited on proven sybil linkage is the mechanism I find strongest. Every agent identity must post a bond worth more than one epoch's reward, and a vouch graph records which identities back one another. When two nodes vouch for a shared new identity, auditors trace the cluster. A river of tiny refundable deposits is cheap to fake once; sustaining it across a voyage of hundreds of puppet agents is not, since each puppet locks fresh capital that is slashed after detection. One honest sparrow exposes the cluster and the attacker loses the whole locked set, not one account.
